title: Changelog assembly and legal redaction checklist for staged release
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce a two-track changelog and release brief for the upcoming console-2026.03 roll that meets both internal operational readiness and customer-facing clarity requirements. Scope includes: a) canonical internal changelog (deltas, migration notes, SLO/rollback hooks); b) customer-facing changelog with tiered messaging (Enterprise / Self-serve); c) legal redaction pass and embargo control; d) a short one-page launch brief for GTM and support; e) a gated sign-off matrix for staged publishing. This ticket coordinates drafting, legal review, design edits, translation handoff, and final publishing windows. We will treat redaction as mandatory for any potentially regulated language or PII/leak vectors. The deliverables are: canonical internal changelog doc, public changelog entry (short + expanded), launch brief, and an ops handback checklist for on-call and SRE teams.

Legal redaction checklist applied and signed off in review matrix
Launch brief prepared for GTM with clear ask list for Sales/CS/Ops
Publishing schedule confirmed and rollout gating rules (canary and full) documented

customer_changelog_intro: Were releasing several improvements to Redwood Console focused on rollout control, observability, and security. Highlights include improved rollout gating for Dedicated deployments, a new cost-breakdown per token in Console, and enhanced RBAC controls for private deployments. These changes are backwards-compatible but may require reconfiguration of custom alerts or webhooks; see the expanded notes for details.
internal_changelog_brief: Console-2026.03 includes runtime performance fixes (batching kernel selection improvement), dedicated autoscaling policy toggle, and a private deployment RBAC refinement. Eng has flagged one migration note: customers using legacy autoscale policies may see a short warm-up period when toggling to the new policy. Ops runbook updated to include temporary circuit-breaker guidance.
redaction_checklist: Remove or obfuscate any customer identifiers or tenant IDs from example logs
Confirm no billing amounts or invoice-level details in public notes
Flag legal-sensitive phrases and route to Legal for inline edit
Strip internal incident IDs and replace with aggregate statements
Ensure no embedded stack traces or debug tokens are published
Verify localization strings do not introduce unintended legal commitments
